comment_text: Thank you for talking to McMorrow. She is an excellent candidate and I think she would do a lot of good for her state and the country. She really focuses on those she is trying to help.
She is the kind of politician I like to see. The kind we need.

Have to say I agree with Manchin. One size fits all legislation is why the US is losing its competitive edge. Why are we listening to a visual arts designer talk about economic policy? Have we lost our ever-loving minds?
